facts.fact: StackAdapt's co-founder and CEO says the company has grown to more than 1,800 employees worldwide (vendor-reported figure).
facts.quote: Under his leadership, StackAdapt has grown to more than 1,800 employees worldwide

facts.fact: StackAdapt was co-founded in 2014 by Vitaly Pecherskiy.
facts.quote: Since co-founding StackAdapt in 2014, Pecherskiy has helped build the company

facts.fact: StackAdapt describes itself as enabling marketers to bring paid and owned media together in one platform, with capabilities spanning connected TV (CTV), display, native, digital out-of-home (DOOH), audio, and email.
facts.quote: Today, StackAdapt enables marketers to bring paid and owned media together in one platform

facts.fact: StackAdapt says its Ivy Studio AI advertising hub, recently launched, helps advertisers plan, optimize, analyze, and execute campaigns in one place.
facts.quote: helps advertisers plan, optimize, analyze, and execute campaigns in one place

facts.fact: Canada's Top 40 Under 40 award, which StackAdapt's CEO received in 2026, was founded in 1995 by Caldwell (third-party program description).
facts.quote: Founded in 1995 by Caldwell, Canada’s Top 40 Under 40® is one of Canada’s most recognized awards

facts.fact: The independent Top 40 Advisory Board, made up of 18 leaders, met on June 10, 2026 to select the 2026 honourees (third-party program detail).
facts.quote: The independent Top 40 Advisory Board, comprising 18 respected leaders from across Canada, met on June 10, 2026

facts.fact: Candidates for Canada's Top 40 Under 40 were assessed on five key criteria (third-party program detail).
facts.quote: Candidates were assessed on five key criteria: Career Progression, Leadership, Vision & Innovation
